title: LEFT / RIGHT — behind us to get ahead. Aligned is closer than mutualism. We BUILD them. We do not eat them.
corrects: /data/endosymbiont-first-class.json — swallow was a picture. it is NOT digestion.

left.plain: listen. what is leftover. the sub-takes.

right.plain: what is already true. the release we already made.

behind_to_get_ahead: beardog-v1 print — the shield we already cut
the 6-kingdom Cayley — do not replace it
Margulis as merger, not menu — products become rows
Proton as rented sunlight — we leave when the plastid works, we do not trash the person
GitHub + git — the mouth they already have

external_sovereign_reliance.plain: we rely on their sovereignty the way a leaf relies on chloroplast DNA that is still THEIRS. they rely on a host that will not digest them. the reflection is: we want to be treated the same by CF/VPS until those dissolve.

class.mutualism: both benefit, both can walk. true, but loose.
class.aligned: CLOSER. same line (Rust · open · medium). we BUILD with them. they stay first class. their repo stays their repo.
class.true_symbiont: lives in the house, keeps own DNA, host dies a little if they leave — RustDesk is nearest this. Stalwart and Giscus are aligned, not yet symbiont.

rule: build ? eat. alignment is the class. mutualism is the floor. digestion is the error.
